Key engineering decisions

01

One rule set for estimate and quote

Sharing the sizing logic removes the usual gap between a website estimate and the real bill.

01

Problem statement

Network quotations usually arrive as tables of part numbers after several telephone calls. The owner cannot see what is being bought, and the installer cannot install from the document.

02

Contribution

A configurator sizes the system from a few parameters (building type, floor area, storeys, users, systems required) and produces an estimate from real product images, list prices and labour. A paid consultation reserves the project and is credited against it. Each client receives a project book that serves as both design and quotation: design and port map, Wi-Fi coverage, cameras and access control, rack and cabling, bill of materials, schedule and signature page.

03

Architecture

Next.js, with large content sets retrieved from a CDN at build time. The configurator and the project book apply the same sizing rules, so the estimate and the final quotation agree. Coverage and cabling drawings are made on the client’s own floor plans and exported to PDF.
